mapper.select: select * from platform_customer_speech where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and request_id=#{requestId}
select count(*) from platform_customer_speech where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId}
select * from platform_customer_speech where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} order by create_time, id limit 40
mapper.update: update platform_customer_speech set usage_json=#{usageJson} where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and id=#{id} and usage_json is null

update platform_customer_speech set status='INTERRUPTED',transcript=null,error_code='SPEECH_INTERRUPTED',finished_time=#{now} where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and request_id=#{requestId} and status='RUNNING'

update platform_customer_speech set status='INTERRUPTED',transcript=null,error_code='SPEECH_EXPIRED',finished_time=#{now} where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and session_id=#{sessionId} and status='RUNNING' and deadline <= #{now}
